## AI Summary

A gazetted exemption changes the rate a business pays, and the only reliable way to know which rate applies is to read the order and its schedule rather than a summary of it. This fixture exists to prove one thing: that the gate now recognises a Malaysian statutory citation as a primary document, which it did not do before 26 October 2026.

## What happened

The order is cited as P.U. (A) 411/2023 and its schedule sets out which goods and persons are exempt. The statutory basis sits in Akta 850, and the notice appears in the Warta Kerajaan.

## Why now

Businesses reprice when a gazette changes, not when a newspaper reports that a change is coming. The order is the operative document; everything else is commentary on it.

## So what

| Item | Instrument | What it settles | Who reads it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Exemption list | P.U. (A) 411/2023 | Which goods are exempt | Importer, accountant |
| Statutory basis | Akta 850 | Who is eligible to be exempted | Legal, compliance |
| Publication | Warta Kerajaan | The date it took effect | Anyone dating a claim |
| Rate | Schedule A | The percentage that applies | Pricing desk |

## What it means for Malaysia

A small importer reading a summary instead of the order will price the wrong rate, and the error compounds across a shipment.

## How confident

Confirmed: the citation format and the statutory basis.

Inferred: nothing about the reader's own eligibility, which depends on their registration.

What would change this: an amending order, which would carry its own P.U. (A) number and its own commencement date.

## For you

- **An importer:** check the schedule against the tariff line before quoting a landed price.
- **An accountant:** the commencement date is in the gazette, not in the announcement.
- **A business owner:** an exemption you have not registered for is an exemption you do not get.

## The data point

> P.U. (A) 411/2023 — the citation is the identifier, and it is what makes the claim checkable.

## FAQ

### Why does the citation matter more than the summary?

Because the citation resolves to one document with one commencement date, while a summary resolves to whoever wrote it. When a rate is disputed, the order is what is produced. A summary cannot be checked against anything, so it cannot settle a disagreement between a buyer and a seller about which rate applied on a given shipment date.

### Is a gazette the same as an announcement?

No. An announcement tells you something happened; a gazette is the instrument that makes it operative. The two usually appear close together, and when they disagree the gazette is the one that governs, because it is the text that was made under the parent Act and published in the official record.

### What should a reader do with this?

Use it as a pattern rather than as advice: find the P.U. (A) number, read the schedule, note the commencement date, and keep the citation next to the number it supports.

## The point

A numbered instrument is the cheapest form of trust available: it can be fetched, dated and read by anyone, without taking the publisher's word for it.
